title: Joop Grand Barrow
body:
Description

The Joop Grand Barrow is the bigger version of the Joop Barrow, having a bigger payload and an extra seat. It costs $7,000 and can be bought at The Oak Depot.

Trivia

  • The part of the name "Joop" is reference to the real life car brand Jeep
  • The license plate is loosely based on the Alabama plate. Mainly that they share the tagline "Sweet Home" followed by the Vehicle registration then the place of origin.
  • Before v1.52.0 price was $5,499
  • in v1.52.0 price was $10,998
